name: Chainer
description: A Cabal dementia summoner who discovers the Mirari and rises through the Cabal's ranks, rivaling the Patriarch, before his fall.

description_citations.text: "Torment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer destroys Cabal City after the Patriarch's exile to Aphetto, which becomes the new center of the Cabal.
timeline.quote: the Patriarch's exile to Aphetto and Cabal City's subsequent destruction by Chainer

citation.text: "Cabal", section "Cities". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer usurps the Cabal and exiles the Patriarch; dementia creatures overrun the city.
timeline.quote: Chainer usurped rulership of the Cabal and exiled the Patriarch to Aphetto

citation.text: "Cabal City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer loses control of the Mirari's power in a pit fight against Kamahl; the city is condemned and abandoned.
timeline.quote: the ruined city was completely abandoned by the Cabal

citation.text: "Cabal City", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer discovers the Mirari in a ruined manor's basement but resists its call, deciding it is fit only for the First of the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Chainer resisted its call, deciding that such power was only fit for the First of the Cabal.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Cabalist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer fights off Order guardsmen on his way to the Patriarch and earns the First's favor.
timeline.quote: earned him the First's favor

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Cabalist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During a dragon attack on the city, Chainer defends the Mirari vaults and uses Death Bloom to shatter a golem and kill Order troops, after his friend Deidre dies.
timeline.quote: Chainer tapped into the ambient power of the Mirari and unleashed the Death Bloom spell, shattering the golem and killing the Order troops.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Caster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer loses his right arm to Jeska's explosive bolt in the pits and receives a golem arm paid for by Skellum.
timeline.quote: where he lost his right arm when he was hit by one of Jeska’s explosive bolts

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Caster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer and Kamahl form a twelve-win pit partnership, broken when Kamahl refuses the First's order to throw a match.
timeline.quote: so he refused to fight and broke off their partnership

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Caster". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl wins sponsorship and enters the pits, first sees the Mirari and befriends Seton and Chainer.
timeline.quote: He first saw the Mirari when he was shown the fighters' prizes and became obsessed with obtaining them.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl returns to Cabal City, partners with Chainer for a record winning streak and refuses the Patriarch's order to throw a match.
timeline.quote: Kamahl refused, as he wanted to win or lose games by his skill rather than on the whims of match-fixers.

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl accompanies Chainer on his ritual shikar and they fight off an ambushing druid and animals.
timeline.quote: Kamahl and Chainer won the fight, but afterward, Kamahl felt a great deal of guilt

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl is badly hurt in the Order's attack on Cabal City and wakes with snakeskin grafted by Chainer using the Mirari; he burns it off.
timeline.quote: To cleanse himself of the additions, Kamahl burnt off his skin and left the hospital

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Mirari drives Chainer mad and warps him into a mass of dementia beasts; dying, he gives the Mirari to Kamahl, who attaches it to his sword.
timeline.quote: As Chainer died, he gave the Mirari to Kamahl

citation.text: "Kamahl", section "Kamahl's Odyssey". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kirtar competes in the Cabal's largest pit-fight tournament in Cabal City, hoping to win an artifact for the Order to destroy.
timeline.quote: Hoping to claim a powerful artifact for the Order to destroy

citation.text: "Kirtar", section "Pit fighter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer finds the Mirari in an old mansion and gives it to the First as a tournament prize.
timeline.quote: The Mirari was found by Chainer in an old mansion

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Discovery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer uses the Mirari to heal Kamahl and then to overthrow the Patriarch and exile him to Aphetto.
timeline.quote: he used it to overthrow the Cabal Patriarch and exile him to Aphetto

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Problems in Cabal City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer is overloaded by the Mirari in a battle with Kamahl, unleashing dementia horrors, and dies.
timeline.quote: he was overwhelmed by his own spell and died.

citation.text: "Mirari", section "Problems in Cabal City". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl arrives at Cabal City lured by a mysterious call and befriends Chainer and Seton.
timeline.quote: There he befriends a young cabalist, Chainer , and a centaur from Krosa, Seton

citation.text: "Odyssey (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer creates the Dementia Snakemen with the Mirari when he exiles the First to Aphetto, sending them ahead to seize the city.
timeline.quote: Dementia Snakemen were created by Chainer when he exiled the First to Aphetto .

citation.text: "Snake", section "Dementia Snakemen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer's insanity touches nearly every living thing.
timeline.quote: Chainer's insanity touched nearly every living thing

citation.text: Waste Away (Torment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Chainer gives a dark gift to a darker soul for Laquatus's champion.
timeline.quote: Chainer's dark gift to a darker soul.

citation.text: Laquatus's Champion (Torment, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Patriarch arranges Skellum's death in a pit fight against an Order squad led by Teroh; Skellum passes his experience to Chainer so he can witness the betrayal, and Chainer swears revenge.
timeline.quote: Chainer was horrified by it and swore revenge against the squad.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer completes his shikar with Kamahl and sees a vision of Kuberr.
timeline.quote: He also saw a vision of the Cabal's god Kuberr

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer fills the central arena with dementia beasts, routing the Order's attack; Kamahl is seriously injured.
timeline.quote: the Order broke off its attack and fled the city.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: To earn use of the Mirari, Chainer slaughters Teroh, his corps, wounded troops in a Samite hospital and many healers.
timeline.quote: slaughtering Teroh, his command corps, all the injured troops recovering in a Samite hospital, and most of the innocent healers as well.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer creates Burke for Laquatus and heals Kamahl with snakeskin; Kamahl burns his skin off, ruining their friendship.
timeline.quote: His refusal to accept the Cabal's gifts ruined his and Chainer's friendship.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer uses the Mirari to power a Death Bloom that kills the Patriarch's guards, forcing the Patriarch into exile in Aphetto, and takes control of Cabal City.
timeline.quote: he took control of Cabal City and, therefore, fulfilled the Mirari’s visions.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Mirari games an Order justiciar and angels attack; infuriated, Chainer taps the dementia space of almost every caster on Otaria, unleashing carnage in Cabal City.
timeline.quote: brought all the creatures he found there into existence inside Cabal City.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl confronts and fights Chainer, melting off his artificial arm; Chainer's healing goes wrong and the Mirari overwhelms him.
timeline.quote: the Mirari’s power finally overwhelmed him, replacing Chainer’s entire body with a writhing mass of dementia creatures.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer begs Kamahl to kill him, and Kamahl does; the Mirari passes to Kamahl.
timeline.quote: while the Mirari now passed on to Kamahl.

citation.text: "Chainer", section "Dementist". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer finds the Mirari outside Cabal City and hands it to the First, who is impressed by his loyalty.
timeline.quote: Despite the temptations of the orb, he decides to hand it to the head of the Cabal

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl and Chainer become friends.
timeline.quote: Kamahl and Chainer quickly become friends.

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl, Seton and Laquatus leave after Kirtar, who has the sphere; Chainer resumes training under Skellum.
timeline.quote: Chainer resumes his training as a dementia summoner under his master Skellum

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Mirari returns to the First, who makes it the prize of the Cabal Anniversary Games; Chainer and Kamahl train as a duo; Llawan claims the throne of the seas.
timeline.quote: Aboshan's wife Llawan claims the throne of the seas

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus starts a civil war in the Mer Empire and schemes with both Order and Cabal; the First sacrifices Skellum in the pits, devastating Chainer.
timeline.quote: In his plotting, he sacrifices Skellum, who dies in the pits to appease them.

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer completes his initiation in Krosa with Kamahl and becomes a full dementia summoner able to master the Mirari; he creates Burke for Laquatus.
timeline.quote: he becomes a full-fledged dementia summoner.

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer disarms the First, fails to kill him, banishes him to Aphetto and takes control of the Cabal, showing signs of corruption.
timeline.quote: He, therefore, banishes him to Aphetto

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Games become a show for Chainer; he loses control of dementia creatures, who overrun the city; he draws them into himself and is corrupted, and makes Kamahl promise to take the Mirari.
timeline.quote: makes Kamahl promise to take it and keep it safe, away from misuse.

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl tearfully witnesses Chainer's death and takes the Mirari as promised.
timeline.quote: Kamahl tearfully witnesses Chainer's death and takes the Mirari, as promised.

citation.text: "Chainer's Torment", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer discovers the Mirari and rises through the Cabal, rivaling the Patriarch before his fall; Kamahl befriends him and Laquatus plots to seize the Mer Empire.
timeline.quote: Chainer's Torment presents the tale of Chainer , a Cabal dementia summoner, discovering the Mirari and rising through the ranks of the Cabal

citation.text: "Torment", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl keeps the Mirari safe from others and himself, keeping his promise to a dying Chainer.
timeline.quote: keeps the Mirari safe from others and himself

citation.text: "Judgment", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl keeps his promise to the dying Chainer and takes the Mirari, attaching it to his sword and fighting off challengers on his way home.
timeline.quote: he takes the Mirari orb for safekeeping.

citation.text: "Judgment (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bretath becomes interim Captain; the Sword of Leadership passes to Teroh, then Commander Eesha.
timeline.quote: Teroh was killed by Chainer before this could be effected

citation.text: "Pianna", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer unearths the Mirari at a forgotten villa outside Cabal City and presents it to the First, who enshrines it as the prize of the Cabal Pit.
timeline.quote: Chainer — ever loyal to the Cabal — presented it to The First

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl is drawn to Cabal City by rumor of the artifact and befriends Chainer and Seton.
timeline.quote: Befriending Chainer and the noble centaur Seton

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer, having lost his mentor Skellum to pit combat arranged by the First, challenges the First with the Mirari and the name Calchexas.
timeline.quote: he challenged the First for leadership, wielding the Mirari

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer banishes the First to Aphetto and takes control of the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Chainer banished him to the southern city of Aphetto and assumed control of the Cabal.

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Mirari twists Chainer's body and mind; his Mirari Games become a massacre.
timeline.quote: Instead, the Games became a massacre.

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Attacked by Order forces, Chainer unleashes horrors from his dementia space upon Cabal City.
timeline.quote: Chainer unleashed every horror from his dementia space upon Cabal City.

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl duels Chainer, who loses his humanity and dissolves into monsters; Kamahl burns the remains with the Mirari.
timeline.quote: Kamahl, honoring his final plea, took up the Mirari and burned Chainer’s monstrous remains

citation.text: "Battle for the Mirari", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Burke is created during the Battle for the Mirari and obeys Laquatus's every command.
timeline.quote: Burke was created during the Battle for the Mirari and obeyed Laquatus's every command

citation.text: "Burke", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer usurps rulership of the Cabal and exiles the Patriarch to Aphetto; the Pit is overrun by dementia creatures.
timeline.quote: Chainer usurped rulership of the Cabal and exiled the Patriarch to Aphetto

citation.text: "Cabal Pit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer loses control of the Mirari's power in a pit fight against Kamahl and the Order.
timeline.quote: Chainer later lost control of the immense power granted to him by the Mirari

citation.text: "Cabal Pit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kamahl and Chainer fight against Devon and kill him.
timeline.quote: with Kamahl against Devon, and killed him

citation.text: "Cabal Pit", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4305 AR, Cabal City is overrun by dementia creatures during the Battle for the Mirari as Chainer usurps the Cabal.
timeline.quote: Chainer usurped rulership of the Cabal and exiled the Patriarch to Aphetto

citation.text: "Docktown", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Chainer loses control of the Mirari's power in a pit fight against Kamahl and the Order; the ruined city is abandoned by the Cabal.
timeline.quote: the ruined city was completely abandoned by the Cabal

citation.text: "Docktown", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Laquatus uses Chainer's dementia beasts; Llawan leads her leviathan, and Chainer's death makes the beasts vanish.
timeline.quote: Llawan led her leviathan into battle

citation.text: "Llawan", section "Civil war". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Skellum trains Chainer to be a full dementist.
timeline.quote: The most famous (and last) graduate of the academy was Chainer

citation.text: "Skellum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Skellum channels his fight to Chainer, then is savaged to death by mandrills.
timeline.quote: allowing a troop of wolf-monkey mandrills controlled by the Order's druid ally to savage Skellum to death

citation.text: "Skellum", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Battle for the Mirari the First is exiled to Aphetto after Laquatus gives Chainer his secret name.
timeline.quote: he was exiled to Aphetto

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Chainer's death the First regains control of the Cabal from Aphetto and plans the Grand Coliseum.
timeline.quote: the First regained control over the Cabal based in Aphetto

citation.text: "Virot Maglan", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
